title: When Is Product Decoding of ECOC MAP-Consistent? Pair Structure and the n-vs-Rest Codes
abstract: arXiv:2611.33044v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Error-Correcting Output Codes (ECOC) combine binary classifiers by the sum decoder, which totals probabilities, or the product decoder, which totals log-likelihoods. In the noiseless setting, where the binary classifiers output the true posteriors, we ask on which code matrices each decoder always agrees with the Bayes-optimal (MAP) class. For the sum decoder the answer is known: the code must be equidistant (James and Hastie, 1998). We answer the question for the product decoder. Two classes are compared through the votes of the columns on which they differ: the sum decoder decides by their sample mean, the product decoder by an M-estimator with influence function artanh, and each vote is the MAP margin plus a bias determined by the other classes alone. Our main theorem states that the product decoder is MAP-consistent if and only if, for every class pair, the columns on which the two classes differ are matched with the columns obtained

translated_title: 《ECOC乘积解码何时具有MAP一致性？配对结构与“一对多”编码》
translated_abstract: 误差校正输出码（ECOC）通过求和解码器（对概率求和）或乘积解码器（对对数似然求和）来组合二元分类器。在无噪声设定下，即二元分类器输出真实后验概率时，我们研究哪些编码矩阵能使每种解码器始终与贝叶斯最优（MAP）类别保持一致。对于求和解码器，答案已为人所知：编码必须是等距的（James and Hastie, 1998）。我们则回答了乘积解码器的这一问题。两个类别通过它们取值不同的列的投票来进行比较：求和解码器依据这些投票的样本均值做决策，而乘积解码器则采用一个影响函数为artanh的M-估计器；每个投票等于MAP间隔加上一个仅由其他类别决定的偏差。我们的主要定理表明，当且仅当对于每一个类别对，两个类别取值不同的列与所得到的列相匹配时，乘积解码器才具有MAP一致性。
tldr: 本文给出了ECOC乘积解码器与贝叶斯最优（MAP）类别保持一致的充要条件——即各类别对之间取值不同的列须满足特定的配对匹配结构，并据此刻画了满足该条件的n-vs-Rest编码。
en_tdlr: The paper derives the necessary and sufficient condition for the ECOC product decoder to be MAP-consistent—a pairwise matching structure over the columns on which class pairs differ—and characterizes the n-vs-Rest codes satisfying it.
